109w · Ongoing · Magic
3988

Summary
"Although it's unfair to you, who has just entered the territory of the demon race, I have to tell you that I am one of the Big Four of the demon race." "Don't underestimate me just because I appear friendly, I am a high-ranking officer in the Demon King's army." "Hmph, don't be proud just because you can defeat me, I am merely the weakest among the Big Four." "Oh no, please spare me, Lord brave! If you keep boiling me, I'll be cooked..."
